title: LM-SimBench: A Unified Framework, Dataset, and Benchmark for Large Language Model Training Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.14285v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating candidate parallelization strategies through distributed training runs makes strategy selection prohibitively expensive at scale. Performance simulation offers a lower cost alternative, yet controlled comparisons among existing simulators remain difficult because they differ in the training stages they model and the workloads on which they are evaluated. We introduce LM-SimBench, a unified framework, profiling dataset, and benchmark for evaluating LLM training simulators. The framework decomposes simulation into functional stages from model compilation to schedule level aggregation, connecting execution representations and cost estimators to measurable evaluation targets. Following this framework, we profile 23 model settings from 10 dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLM families on an Ascend Neural Processing Unit (NPU) cluster. The resulting dataset contains 348 feasible configurations that jointly vary five parallelism dim

translated_title: LM-SimBench：面向大语言模型训练仿真的统一框架、数据集与基准
translated_abstract: 通过分布式训练实际运行来评估候选并行化策略，使得在大规模场景下的策略选择成本高得令人望而却步。性能仿真提供了一种成本更低的替代方案，然而现有仿真器之间的受控比较仍然困难，因为它们在建模的训练阶段以及所评估的工作负载上各不相同。我们提出了LM-SimBench，这是一个用于评估大语言模型训练仿真器的统一框架、性能剖析数据集和基准。该框架将仿真过程分解为从模型编译到调度层聚合的各个功能阶段，将执行表示和成本估计器与可衡量的评估目标联系起来。遵循该框架，我们在昇腾（Ascend）神经处理单元（NPU）集群上对来自10个稠密及混合专家（MoE）大语言模型家族的23种模型设置进行了性能剖析。所得数据集包含348种可行配置，这些配置在五个并行维度上共同变化。
tldr: 该论文提出LM-SimBench，通过统一的仿真分解框架、基于昇腾NPU集群的大规模性能剖析数据集以及标准化基准，首次实现了对不同大语言模型训练仿真器的公平、系统化评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LM-SimBench, a unified framework, profiling dataset, and benchmark that enables fair and systematic evaluation of LLM training simulators, featuring 348 configurations profiled across 23 model settings from 10 dense and MoE LLM families on an Ascend NPU cluster.
